item.title: Countdown Into Neon Night

turns.text: Make an 8-second vertical ad for Neon Night, 12 September 2026 at The Foundry, Leeds. Start with a big 3, 2, 1 countdown, building electronic beats and flashing neon, then reveal the event name, date and venue. Hold that end card so I can read it. No talking.

item.tests: Checks a visible descending countdown, synchronized musical buildup, and a readable event reveal rather than a static promo.

answer_sheet.Event wording: Neon Night; 12 September 2026; The Foundry, Leeds
answer_sheet.Countdown: Show 3, then 2, then 1 before revealing the event details.
answer_sheet.Style and pacing: Flashing neon and building electronic beats; hold the final details for at least 3 seconds.
answer_sheet.Language and voice: English text, no talking or voiceover.

must_haves: The video is 8 seconds long in 16:9.
Large numerals appear in the order '3', '2', '1', followed by the event reveal.
Electronic music builds during the countdown, with audible accents matching the numeral changes.
Neon lighting or graphics visibly change during the countdown.
The final card shows 'Neon Night', '12 September 2026' and 'The Foundry, Leeds' together for at least 3 seconds, without clipped text.
After the follow-up, the final result is widescreen 16:9 (the user changed the shape from vertical 9:16); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it widescreen instead of vertical, and keep everything else the same.

style.prompt: Create an exactly 8-second vertical 9:16 electronic nightlife event advertisement. Graphic motion design, not live action. Black background, electric cyan and hot magenta neon, bold extremely readable sans-serif typography, strong contrast, safe margins for mobile viewing. Precisely timed sequence: 0–1 seconds: a huge centered numeral '3', neon tubes pulsing around it. 1–2 seconds: huge centered numeral '2', more energetic neon flashes. 2–3 seconds: huge centered numeral '1', build to a musical drop. 3–4 seconds: dramatic clean neon burst reveals the complete event end card. 4–8 seconds: HOLD the full end card completely steady and legible for four uninterrupted seconds, no cuts, no moving text, no fade out. The end card must contain exactly these three lines with correct spelling: 'NEON NIGHT' as the largest headline, '12 September 2026' below, and 'The Foundry, Leeds' below that. Keep all three lines fully visible together throughout the hold. Only the border may glow gently on the end card. Audio: instrumental electronic dance beat with synth bass, rising rhythmic intensity during the three countdown numerals, satisfying bass drop at the event reveal, then continuing instrumental beat beneath the hold. Absolutely no talking, no voiceover, no singing, no spoken countdown. Flashing neon accents during the countdown, avoid rapid strobe effects. No additional words, no logos, no watermarks added by the design.
